# WiseTwin

> WiseTwin is a French consulting and services firm that develops digital solutions for
> industry. Founded by three partners with industrial backgrounds, it accelerates the
> digital transformation of industrial companies with tailor-made tools — training, HSE,
> 3D, data & AI — that are fast to deploy, affordable, interoperable, and sized for a
> single site's budget. It also publishes two standardized products born from recurring
> client needs: WiseTrainer LMS (training) and WiseAtlas (communication).

WiseTwin's philosophy: operational excellence and industrial performance come from tools
designed for the teams who use them, without disrupting their daily work. Digital must be
accessible in price and in design time; answers should be fast, tailor-made, and sized on
real identified needs. All solutions are interoperable and multi-platform (browser,
mobile, tablet, VR — no lock-in). Projects start small: a first focused deliverable
builds trust, then the tool grows over time.

Primary language: French (site available at /fr and /en). Website: https://wisetwin.eu

## Services (custom development & consulting)

- Training & HSE: training digitization, virtual & VR training, safety inductions, risk
  hunts, serious games, HSE prevention plans, self-paced training, training planning and
  traceability
- 3D, immersive & video: virtual tours, layout and flow simulation, digital twins of
  facilities, 3D explainers, video and course production
- Data, AI & software: custom business applications, websites, artificial intelligence,
  cloud engineering, document management, production monitoring, performance tracking,
  communication tools
- Consulting & organization: transformation diagnosis, industrial performance,
  operational excellence, change management

How it works: free discussion and diagnosis → proposal and free quote within 48h →
iterative development in weeks → deployment and ongoing support. Deliverables belong to
the client.

## Products (standardized tools born in the field)

- WiseTrainer LMS — the modular industrial training platform, from €50/month per site.
  Base plan: hosting and delivery of training, WisePaper (documents turned into
  interactive training with AI quizzes), Safety Tour (photo-realistic safety induction),
  completion tracking, unlimited learners. À la carte modules: advanced analytics,
  training plans and reminders, SSO/MFA/audit, SCORM/API integrations, guest mode,
  cross-organization sharing. 3D simulators of the client's own facilities are custom
  projects billed once — the 3D asset belongs to the client.
- WiseAtlas — interactive 4D map for territories and industrial infrastructure, from
  €3,000/year. 3D models, virtual tours, up-to-date data, shareable in one link.

## The team

- Manoel — data, AI & software: business applications, data pipelines, AI components,
  cloud infrastructure
- Mickaël — 3D, visualization & simulation: simulators, virtual tours, digital twins in
  real-time 3D
- Gauthier — consulting & operational excellence: transformation diagnosis, industrial
  performance, change management

## Company

- WiseTwin is a French company based in Dunkerque, serving industrial sites of all sizes
  (SMEs to large groups), local authorities and territorial players
- Contact: contact@wisetwin.eu — free quote within 48h, no commitment
- Security: MFA, enterprise SSO, audit logs, GDPR-compliant, data hosted in Europe,
  ISO 27001 best practices
